name: Paychef Payments for WooCommerce
author: Paychef

sections.description:
Website: www.paychef.com

The Paychef payment gateway is a simple method to integrate all major payment methods in WooCommerce with one single payment gateway. The Paychef Payment Gateway helps you to accept credit card payments securely.

The Paychef plugin extends WooCommerce allowing you to take payments directly on your store via Paychef’s API.

Paychef provides you with an optimal payment page that is fully optimized for mobile devices and supports all major payment methods, especially in Europe. You can easily and quickly integrate it into your WooCommerce shop, while customizing the design to your preferences.

Webhook IP Address: 52.29.45.62, 3.79.212.4, 3.73.29.220

External Services

This plugin connects to the Google Pay API to enable Google Pay as a payment method in your WooCommerce checkout.

What is Google Pay and what is it used for:
Google Pay is a digital wallet platform that allows customers to make secure payments using their saved payment methods. This plugin loads the Google Pay JavaScript library to display the Google Pay payment option during checkout.

What data is sent and when:
When a customer selects Google Pay as their payment method, payment information is transmitted directly between the customer’s browser and Google’s servers. The plugin loads the Google Pay JavaScript library (https://pay.google.com/gp/p/js/pay.js) when the checkout page is accessed.

Third-party service information:
– Service: Google Pay API
– Service URL: https://pay.google.com
– Terms of Service: https://payments.google.com/payments/apis-secure/get_legal_document?ldo=0&ldt=googlepaytos
– Privacy Policy: https://payments.google.com/payments/apis-secure/get_legal_document?ldo=0&ldt=privacynotice

PAYMENT METHODS

  • Mastercard
  • VISA
  • AMEX
  • Masterpass
  • Maestro
  • TWINT
  • PostFinance Card
  • PostFinance E-Finance
  • Diners Club
  • Discover
  • Pay By Bank
  • xMoney
  • Powerpay
  • CembraPay
  • Rechnung (Invoice)
  • Banküberweisung (Swiss-QR)
  • Apple Pay
  • Google Pay
  • Samsung Pay
  • Centi
  • iDeal
  • Sofort
  • Alipay
  • WeChat Pay
  • Przelewy24
  • Reka
  • Klarna

Supported external payment service providers:
* PayPal
* Stripe
* Boncard
* Lunch Check
* Coinbase (Bitcoin etc.)
* WIRpay

Why choose Paychef?

Paychef is a cost-effective payment gateway option that offers a transparent fee structure with no setup fees, no monthly fees, and no hidden costs. You only get charged when you make a transaction, which makes it an excellent choice for small and medium-sized businesses. Your earnings are automatically transferred to your bank account on a 7-day rolling basis.

FEATURES

  • Support for full and partial payment refunds directly in the WordPress Order
  • Transparent pricing. No startup fees, no monthly fees, and no gateway fees. No hidden fees, period.
  • Compatible with WooCommerce Subscriptions for recurring payments (Apple Pay, credit card, iDEAL, )
  • Support for all available Mollie payment methods
  • Edit the title of the payment method in WooCommerce checkout
  • WordPress Multisite support
  • Multiple translations: English, Dutch, German and French
  • Fast in-house support. You will always be helped by someone who knows our products intimately.
  • We’ll accompany you through the onboarding process
sections.installation:
• Download the plugin
  • Install the plugin using the .zip archive
  • Activate the installed plugin in your WooCommerce Backend
  • Configure the plugin in your Paychef Account
  • Enter the title which should be displayed during checkout, your instance name (e.g. example.paychef.com => example) and the API secret which you can find in your Paychef administration interface under Settings > API
  • Configure the webhook URL in Paychef, use the URL to your shop and add /?wc-api=wc_paychef_gateway
sections.faq:
Does this support recurring payments, like for subscriptions?

Yes!

Does this require an SSL certificate?

No!

Does this support both production mode and sandbox mode for testing?

Absolutely, you can easily switch between production and test (sandbox) mode directly in the Paychef dashboard. Simply navigate to the appropriate settings section and select the mode you prefer. It’s quick, easy, and hassle-free!

Where can I get support or talk to other users?

If you get stuck, you can ask for help in the Plugin Forum.

My firewall have blocked the webhook what i should do?

Go to the Firewall setting and whitelist the follow IP:
Webhook IP Address: 52.29.45.62
